items.title: Are YouTubers taking over the film industry?

items.title: Child detainees in Queensland allegedly locked down for entire weekend

items.title: Government flags risk of relying on Elon Musk's SpaceX and Starlink
items.description: As tens of thousands of Australians line up to buy shares in Elon Musk's SpaceX blockbuster public offering, Australian government officials are privately flagging the risks posed by the country's growing reliance on its satellite internet service, Starlink.

items.title: Taylor rules out One Nation seat carve-up as party raises $2m
items.description: Opposition leader Angus Taylor says the Coalition has no plan to share the seats the party targets at the next federal election with One Nation as Pauline Hanson's party says it has raised $2 million since launch.

items.title: World's biggest whale graveyard found in Indian Ocean off Australia
items.description: Hundreds of whale fossils, including those from extinct species new to science, range in age from recent to 5 million years old and are also home to undescribed deep-sea creatures.
